Senses.Explanation: Yuanwu and Yinyuan say even Linji, Deshan, buddhas, or patriarchs are left staring and agape; other records turn the same reaction on a participant whose move is exposed. The witnesses attach the same staring eyes and open mouth to being stopped, exposed, or unable to respond across sermons, verse, and appraisal.
